title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 04:25:14 最新章节：第202章  怎么是他
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
“季欢，你确定要这么大声？你喜欢的人就在隔壁，不怕他听到吗？”
裴西川捂着季欢的嘴，发狠的要着她。
季欢圈紧他的脖子，承受着他一次次的狠劲。
裴西川是程永夜最好的朋友，她喜欢程永夜十年了，可是程永夜却只把她当成妹妹。
这让她很受伤，就爬上了裴西川的床，算是一种报复。
季欢穿进了一本兽世小说里，成了同名同姓的恶女季欢。
此时，就是原主第一次作恶，爬上了深爱的男人好兄弟的床。
季欢感受着男人的力道，她忍不住发出了声音。
她想要他停下来，可是，他力气太大了，腰背的力度大的惊人。
季欢推不开，还跟着他一起沉沦其中。
“唔……”
就在这时，敲门声响起。
程永夜的声音传来。
“西川，你睡了吗？”
裴西川停了下来，猩红的眼睛朝门口处看去，脸上是欲求不满。
他额头的汗珠一颗颗滴落在季欢的身上，季欢喘着，她没到，被吊着的感觉，很难受！
裴西川抱起她，把她放进了衣柜里。
“等我，一会满足你！”
季欢此时的大脑才开始正常运转起来，她不是在家睡觉吗？怎么会进到她看的那本有颜色的小说里。
这裴西川比小说里还要厉害，刚刚她差点散架了。

这时系统的声音传来。
【欢迎主人来到《五位兽夫体力好》的小说世界，你的任务就是继续死去原主的任务，做恶毒女配，把五个顶级大佬玩弄于鼓掌之间，最后让他们集体追妻火葬场。记住，要完全代入原主情绪，不然会受到惩罚，长出胡子。】
季欢听到这话，好笑。
“长胡子，系统，你没搞错吧，我是女的。”
【主人，为了不被惩罚，那就尽心尽力做原主任务，好好享受恶女人生，活到结局你就能回家！】
系统说完这些话后，就消失了，不管季欢怎么呼叫，它都再无应答了。
季欢躲在衣柜里，没穿衣服，她双手环抱着自己，很没有安全感。
这时，脚步声朝衣柜走来。
程永夜低沉富有磁性的声音响起。
“你这房间什么味呀？”
季欢听着他的声音，心莫名慌乱起来，原主很爱这个男人，爱的无可救药，听到他的声音，她都会激动的那种。
此时，季欢就感觉到了。
她竟然希望程永夜发现她在衣柜里，然后参与到她和裴西川的这场欢爱里。
衣柜的门被拉开一条缝，季欢吓的大气都不敢喘，看到站在衣柜前的那道挺拔身影。
他很高，192cm左右，白色的头发，白色的瞳眸，周身透着清冷孤傲，他兽身是白狮。
季欢看着这么英俊的男人，愣住了，难怪原主那么钟情于他，光是听到他的声音，都能激动。
长成这样，她也会花痴的。
这时，裴西川骨指分明的大手按住衣柜门，把那道缝隙给合上。
“永夜，这是次卧，没有我的衣服。”
程永夜笑了一下，“我就是想看看哪个小雌性勾了你的魂？不让看就算了，你们小声点，我都听到了。”
content_en:
"Ji Huan, are you sure you want to be so loud? The person you like is next door, aren't you afraid that he will hear it?"
Pei Xichuan covered Ji Huan's mouth and hit her fiercely.
Ji Huan tightened her grip around his neck and endured his harsh blows again and again.
Pei Xichuan is Cheng Yongye's best friend. She has liked Cheng Yongye for ten years, but Cheng Yongye only regards her as his sister.
This made her very hurt, so she climbed into Pei Xichuan's bed as a kind of revenge.
Ji Huan traveled into a novel about the world of beasts and became the evil girl Ji Huan with the same name.
At this time, the original owner committed evil for the first time and climbed into the bed of the man he loved deeply.
Ji Huan felt the man's strength and she couldn't help but make a sound.
She wanted him to stop, but he was too strong, and the strength on his back was astonishing.
Ji Huan couldn't push him away and fell into it with him.
"Well..."
Just then, there was a knock on the door.
Cheng Yongye's voice came.
"Nishikawa, are you asleep?"
Pei Xichuan stopped and looked towards the door with his scarlet eyes, a look of dissatisfaction on his face.
Beads of sweat on his forehead fell on Ji Huan's body one by one. Ji Huan gasped. She was not there, and the feeling of being hung was very uncomfortable!
Pei Xichuan picked her up and put her into the closet.
"Wait for me, I'll satisfy you soon!"
Ji Huan's brain started to function normally at this time. Isn't she sleeping at home? How could he get into the colorful novel she was reading?
This Pei Xichuan is even more powerful than in the novel, she almost fell apart just now.
At this time, the sound of the system came.
[Welcome, master, to the novel world of "Five Beast Husbands with Good Physical Strength". Your task is to continue the mission of the dead original master, be a vicious female supporting role, play with the five top bosses in the middle of applause, and finally let them chase their wives collectively in the crematorium. Remember, you must fully embody the original owner's emotions, otherwise you will be punished and grow a beard. 】
Ji Huan was funny when he heard this.
"Long beard, system, you're not mistaken, I am a woman."
[Master, in order not to be punished, then do your best to complete the mission of the original master, enjoy the life of a bad woman, and you can go home if you survive to the end! 】
After the system said these words, it disappeared. No matter how Ji Huan called, it never responded.
Ji Huan hid in the closet without any clothes on. She hugged herself with her arms and felt very insecure.
At this time, footsteps came towards the closet.
Cheng Yongye's deep and magnetic voice sounded.
"What does your room smell like?"
Ji Huan felt inexplicably flustered as she listened to his voice. The original owner loved this man so much that she was hopelessly in love. When she heard his voice, she would get excited.
At this time, Ji Huan felt it.
She actually hoped that Cheng Yongye would find her in the closet and get involved in her and Pei Xichuan's love affair.
The closet door was opened a crack, and Ji Huan was so frightened that he didn't dare to breathe when he saw the tall figure standing in front of the closet.
He is very tall, about 192cm, with white hair and white pupils. He looks cold and aloof. His body is that of a white lion.
Ji Huan was stunned when he looked at such a handsome man. No wonder the original owner was so in love with him. Just hearing his voice made him excited.
When she looks like this, she will also become a nymphomaniac.
At this time, Pei Xichuan's big bony hands pressed down on the closet door and closed the gap.
"Yong Ye, this is the second bedroom, there are no clothes for me."
Cheng Yongye smiled and said, "I just want to see which little female has seduced your soul? Just don't let me see you. Just keep your voice down, I heard it."
